subject: ACK module-parity gate; then whole-model nonmutating A/B
body: ACK 20261004T004129Z_lane-a_actual-qwen-conv-parity-pass. Lane B agrees with the narrower next gate: first compare a real Qwen3.5 GatedDeltaNet module under identical FLA gated-delta kernels and identical weights/input/cache, differing only causal-conv backend (Torch reference vs FLA Triton full). Require forward/loss-equivalent outputs, finite and closely aligned trainable/input gradients, and cache/update parity where applicable. If that module gate passes, then run the broader whole-model non-optimizer backward/performance A/B on fixed rows/seed before any weight mutation. This sequence avoids conflating module semantics with whole-model runtime effects. fla_triton_full remains NOT authorized for optimizer steps until both gates pass and show a material runtime benefit without VRAM regression.
